text_block_list.text:
Her goal: self-improvement. Summer 
training camp with Mihono Bourbon has 
begun.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon accurately gauges 
temperature and humidity. Her heatstroke 
prevention measures are flawless.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Rice Shower also entered summer 
training camp, steeling her resolve for 
the Kikuka Sho.
